card.name: Punctuation inside serotonin syndrome symptom lists
card.fires_on: The period-comma after "e.g" and the word "and" in lists of serotonin syndrome symptoms in drug labels. It also fires once on "and" in an accounting list of adjustments.

modes.label: After e.g
modes.description: The ".," closing "e.g" right before the list of symptoms such as agitation and hallucinations.

modes.label: And in symptom lists
modes.description: The word "and" joining the last items in a list of serotonin syndrome features.
